COUNT(email) excludes NULL values; COUNT(*) includes them. That's the 20-row gap.

The difference: COUNT(column) counts non-NULL entries in that column. COUNT(*) counts rows regardless of content. So if 20 users have NULL in the email field, you get exactly this result—980 vs 1000.
